en: O glorious Ananta, adorned with divine splendor, Appala Lakṣmī Narasiṃha Rāja, may you be victorious!
May you be triumphant in the conquest of all directions! May you be the illustrious, unbroken, and ever-victorious one! ||1||
O Śrīvidyādhari Rādhā, O Surekhā, O Śrīrākhidharā, O Śrīpādā, be victorious, be ever-conquering, be the conqueror of all directions, and be the glorious, undivided, and truly victorious one! 2.
Victory to the feet of the Mother Sumati, nourished by the nectar of maternal affection!
Victory! O Victorious One, be victorious; be victorious in the conquest of all directions! O Illustrious One, remain forever invincible and victorious! ||3||
O Lord of Sages, delighter of the daughters of truth, praised by Brahmā and the Āryas, victory to Your glorious feet!
Be victorious, be a conqueror of the quarters; O possessor of glorious, unbroken splendor, be ever triumphant! ||4||

O you who have attained the meritorious fruit of the Sāvitrī-kāṭhaka-pile, born of the Bhāradvāja ṛṣi lineage: be victorious, be triumphant, be a conqueror of the quarters; O illustrious one, be ever-victorious with unbroken glory! ||5||
O four-footed deity, awakened by the great friend Lakṣmī, whose feet are glorious;
be victorious, be a conqueror of the quarters, be the illustrious, indivisible, and glorious Vijayī! ||6||

O son of Rājamāmbā, born as the fruit of the merit of your womb, you who are the very embodiment of virtue—victory to you! Be victorious! Be a conqueror of the quarters! O illustrious one, be ever-victorious with unbroken glory! ||7||

O delighter of Sumati, O delighter of Narahari, O Lord who grants divine grace, victory to Your glorious feet! Be victorious, be a conqueror of the quarters; O illustrious and indivisible one, be ever triumphant! ||8||
The city of Pīṭhikāpurī, a perpetual abode, has been given as Madhumatī, the embodiment of auspiciousness;
victory! Be victorious! Be a conqueror of the quarters! O glorious and unbroken one, be victorious with splendor! ||9||
